<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">We hereby consent to the inclusion in this Form 10 of our audit report dated August 19, 2026, with respect to the balance sheets of Biomolecular
Life Holdings, Inc. (f/k/a VG Life Sciences, Inc.) as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, and the related statements of operations, changes
in stockholders&rsquo; deficit, and cash flows for each of the years in the two-year period ended December 31, 2025. Our report relating
to those financial statements includes an emphasis of matter paragraph regarding substantial doubt as to the Company&rsquo;s ability to
continue as a going concern.</FONT></P>
